name: Input
title: Input
summary: Rounded 48px text field with its label above, available as the React `Input` and as `.field` › `.label` + `.input` with hint, error and success messages.
whenToUse: Use for short free text: name, email, order number, partner code, search terms in a form.
Use `.input-lg` (60px) for the one or two big fields of a sign-up or give flow; use the amount field (`.cr-amount`) for a gift amount.
Use `<textarea class="input">` for messages and prayer requests.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for a choice from a known list; use Select, Radio or Combobox. For search bars use SearchField; for phone numbers use PhoneInput.

anatomy.description: Label above, field, then one line of hint OR error OR success below.

props.name: size
props.description: Field size. `lg` (60px) is for the one or two big fields of a sign-up or give flow and also enlarges the label.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Adornment shown inside the start of the field, for example a currency symbol (renders the `.cr-amount` field, pair with `size="lg"`). Decorative.

react.notes: `import { Input, Textarea } from '@ism/ui'`. Renders the same `.field` › `.label` + `.input` markup as the HTML below and wires `for`/`id`, `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` for you. `Textarea` takes the same field props except `size`, `prefix` and `type`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the field. Always provide one; the placeholder is only an example.

props.name: optionalLabel
props.description: Appended to the label for optional fields, e.g. "(optional)". Pass the localized word.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field. Hidden while `error` or `success` is shown.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message under the field. Sets the error border and fill, and announces the message.

props.name: success
props.description: Success message under the field. Show only where a check really ran.

props.name: type
props.description: Semantic type that sets keyboard, autofill and capitalisation. Explicit props override it.

props.name: size
props.description: Field height: 48dp default or 60dp for the one or two big fields of a flow.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and copyable but not editable; shows a lock icon.

props.name: showPasswordLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the password show toggle.

props.name: hidePasswordLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the password hide toggle.

props.name: startAdornment
props.description: Element at the start of the field (decorative).

variantNotes: Sizes: default 48px, `.input-lg` 60px (pair with `.cr-label-lg` 17px label), amount 76px. Textarea starts at 144px and resizes vertically. React: `size="lg"`, `prefix` for the amount field, `dark` for dark surfaces.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always show a visible `.label` above the field. Placeholders are examples only.
Keep fields at least 48px tall; that also covers the 44px tap target.
Validate on blur, not on every keystroke. On submit, move focus to the first field with an error.
Show success only where a check really ran (server-confirmed email, partner code). Never on every field.
Disabled fields are skipped by Tab and not submitted; read-only fields can be focused, copied and are submitted.
Mark the fewer kind: most ISM forms are mostly required, so label the rest `(optional)` with `.opt`.
The focus ring is the only blue on a field; never colour borders `--horizon-blue` at rest.

dont: Do not use for a choice from a known list; use Select, Radio or Combobox. For search bars use SearchField; for phone numbers use PhoneInput.
accessibility: Tie the label with `for`/`id`. Tie hints and errors with `aria-describedby`.
Set `aria-invalid="true"` on errors and give the error an icon plus text, never colour alone.
Use the right `type`, `autocomplete` and `inputmode` so phones show the right keyboard.
Icons inside `.cr-adorn-end` are decorative (`aria-hidden="true"`); say the state in text.
content: Labels are nouns in sentence case: "Email", "Your full name", "Prayer request".
Placeholders show a real example: "you@example.com", "e.g. Maria Santos", "How can we help?".
Errors say how to fix it: "Enter a full email address.", "Please enter your name." Success is short: "Looks good."

react:
<Input label="Email" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com" error="Enter a full email address." />
<Input label="Order #" optional hint="For questions about an ISM Publishing or NFC card order." />
<Input label="Gift amount (USD)" size="lg" prefix="$" inputMode="decimal" defaultValue="50" />
<Textarea label="Prayer request" placeholder="How can we help?" />
